NOTICE OF MATERIAL BREACH AND DEMAND TO CURE

Sent by certified mail, return receipt requested, and by email to
notices@northstar-analytics.com.

Date: October 4, 2024

From: Ridgeline Manufacturing Corp.
      Attn: General Counsel
      4400 Industrial Way, Cleveland, Ohio.

To:   Northstar Analytics, Inc.
      Attn: Legal Department
      200 Market Street, San Francisco, California.

Re:   Master Services Agreement dated March 3, 2024, and Statement of Work
      No. 1 dated March 15, 2024 (together, the "Agreement").

This letter is notice of material breach under Section 3 of the Agreement.

The following breaches remain outstanding:
1. Milestone M3 (production cutover on Lines A and B), scheduled for
   August 30, 2024, was not delivered. As of the date of this letter, Line B
   remains in a partially-cut-over state and is producing corrupt telemetry.
2. Provider's ingestion pipeline has failed the 99.9% monthly uptime
   commitment for July, August, and September 2024, with measured uptime of
   96.8%, 94.1%, and 91.7% respectively.
3. Provider failed to conclude the Customer training required under
   Section 1(d) of SOW No. 1; only six of the fifteen contracted personnel
   have been trained.

Ridgeline has suffered material harm as a direct result. Ridgeline is invoking
the thirty (30) day cure period in Section 3 of the Agreement. Provider must
cure each of the foregoing breaches on or before November 3, 2024, failing
which Ridgeline will terminate the Agreement for cause and pursue all
available remedies, including damages, cover, and any other relief authorized
by law or the Agreement.

Nothing in this letter waives any right or remedy available to Ridgeline. All
rights are expressly reserved.

Signed, M. Alvarado, General Counsel, Ridgeline Manufacturing Corp.
